def: a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively)

words.word: by the things that are made

occurrences.text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
words: by the things that are made

occurrences.text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
